17:10 < Filip_> antagonizt ? 
17:10 < Filip_> was it you asking about the switch next to the cf slot ?
17:11 < Filip_> think I know why it's there: Casio sells a pcmcia adapter for the CF slot, and found this in the headers:  #define PCMCIA_JACK_DETECT
17:25 < antagonizt> cool... that makes sense
17:25 < Filip_> also found some more regs
17:25 < Filip_> 0xaa000980  BlgReg_BASE ,size 0x68 (Casio SDK, buzzer.h)  
17:25 < Filip_> 0xaa001128  CmmReg_BASE ,size 0x04 (Casio SDK, buzzer.h)  
17:26 < Filip_> added both to my memory map
17:26 < antagonizt> for the buzzer? right?
17:27 < Filip_> well, there in buzzer.h  , but Cmm and Blg don't ring a bell (or buzzer)  for me
17:27 < Filip_> maybe just try to poke some data into those
18:00 -!- jal0atWrk [~jal0_wrkn@208.33.58.197] has joined #linux4be
18:02 < Filip_> hi jal0
18:03 < jal0atWrk> hey filip
18:04 < Filip_> seen you progress, and your problem
18:04 < Filip_> looks similar to the lock-ups I was experiencing with the bootloader
18:04 < Filip_> always froze at certain adressess, never found out why. 
18:04 < jal0atWrk> yes strange, still havnt figured it out
18:05 < Filip_> maybe triggering some kind of interupt, which is not handled ?
18:05 < jal0atWrk> actually it dosnt freeze, the program just restarts like its first being ran
18:06 < jal0atWrk> which is strange because the code is in a while(1) loop
18:07 < jal0atWrk> did you still plan on sending me that pcb?
18:07 < Filip_> could it be there is a peripheral ic  at that location, and notices being read, generating an interrupt ?
18:07 < Filip_> yes, could you mail/pm me a shipping address?
18:08 < jal0atWrk> maybe, but the program should return to where it left off not restart
18:08 < jal0atWrk> and all i'm doing is reading from the address
18:08 < jal0atWrk> yeap
18:09 < jal0atWrk> really would help getting a mapping of the bus layout
18:10 < Filip_> I  was browsing the SDK headers once  more, and added two addresses from buzzer.h to the memorymap
18:11 < jal0atWrk> have you tried getting buzzer to work?
18:11 < Filip_> I also read some documentation on writing device drivers for windows ce today, and it looks like touchpanel code has to be in a separate DLL (and not liniked in with the kernel)
18:12 < jal0atWrk> hmm, got a link?
18:12 < Filip_> no, might try poking some data into these adresses and if it does something
18:12 < Filip_> this is one of them http://www.embedded.com/story/OEG20010618S0083
18:13 < Filip_> Native drivers are built as dynamic-link libraries, with two exceptions: the battery and the LED drivers are built as static libraries (linked with the GWES module when a CE image is built) because of their small size. Native drivers are always loaded at boot time. 
18:13 < jal0atWrk> so that static lib should be included with the be300 sdk?
18:13 < Filip_> which is good: a dedicated dll for touchscreen means less code to look at
18:14 < Filip_> not sure if casio included it (it's not supposed to contain user-calable code)
18:15 < Filip_> (I couldn't find it)
18:16 < jal0atWrk> yes, but you should be able to create 3rd party drivers, without kernel code. if the buzzer requires the use of a static lib, it should be included. i look for it when i get home.
18:17 < Filip_> no, you are supposed to use the higher-level sound api's, not drive the underlying hardware directly
18:17 < jal0atWrk> they do not support 3rd party drivers?
18:17 < Filip_> well, there is a buzzer.libi
18:18 < Filip_> libi
18:18 < Filip_> =lib
18:18 < jal0atWrk> whats the size?
18:18 < Filip_> contains 7 entries, 4 of around 40 bytes, 
18:19 < Filip_> 250,277 and491 bytes
18:19 < jal0atWrk> so its not just an import lib
18:19 < jal0atWrk> contains actual code
18:20 < Filip_> hmm, loads external lib's  (which IDA can't find)
18:20 < jal0atWrk> what libs?
18:21 < jal0atWrk> may be form PB, that i have and can look for
18:21 < jal0atWrk> form=from
18:24 < Filip_> looking atit with hexeditor, itdoesn't seem to do anything, looks like a simple import lib
18:24 < Filip_> goinig to re-inistall my evc tomorrow
18:30 < Filip_> http://www.woodmann.com/fravia/nchanta_Abusing%20Microsoft%20EVT2.htm
18:40 < Filip_> going to get some sleep now,  cu later
